findings.summary: `.first()` was never called on the flow, so `initialState` is a `Flow<ProgramState?>` object, not the state itself.
findings.mechanism: `programStateRepo.observe(program.id)` returns `Flow<ProgramState?>`; the code assigns it directly to `initialState` (never suspending to collect a value) despite importing `kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first` for this purpose. `if (initialState == null)` is comparing a non-null Flow object to null, which is always false, so the app always resolves `TopLevelRoute.Main` and users who have never completed onboarding are routed straight to the main app instead of onboarding.
